properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (branch feat/argument-skill-step-objections). getting-started/skills/design-an-argument/SKILL.md and the /design-an-argument command: cases are Constraints taken as given; principles are chosen, taken up in `assumed` by each step that applies one, so every position reads conditional on its principle and a position several principles support names every line (`holds_under_any_of`); objections are statements of their own drawn as CONTRADICTS to a position, a premise or the step's own id; replies answer objections; rival positions are a CONTRADICTS each way or a Decision the owner keeps `contested`, never a single CONTRADICTS (one that holds outright reads the other refuted, and which side loses depends only on the edge's direction); a read-back per position with reasoning_report and the whole-design summary lists. find_skills ranks it first for "argument", "line of reasoning", "for and against" and "design an argument"; design-a-proof's description points to it instead of sending the case to a Decision. Honest limits named in the skill: no read-back from a dispute Decision to its positions, no "not an inference" step, no concede-and-move reply, no record for a principle silent on a case, and a what-if says nothing about a principle taken up in `assumed`.
properties.name: A served skill teaches designing an argument for and against: cases, principles, positions, objections aimed at what they attack, replies, and rival positions kept as an open dispute
